name: Arthur W. Smith
role: Medora resident; nominee for Billings County surveyor
bio: Arthur W. Smith appears in the paper's comic local items, plunging into the icy Little Missouri after a bale of hay in March 1884 and struggling with a runaway bronco team that July. He had an accident in April 1885 and spent part of that fall hunting strayed stock, recovering a horse near Miles City. In March 1886 both county tickets named him for county surveyor, but he declined and asked to resign in favor of D. O. Sweet, though his name stayed on the ballot.
